verses.transcription: wajjahtu lil laahi wajhii wahwa yubqinii
wa bil lazii faaqa zannii qad yulaqqiinii
qawlii wa haqdii wa fihlii lil halin sarafat

verses.text: وَالْعَامَ لِى رَاضَ خِبًّا كَادَ يُرْدِينِى
verses.transcription: wal haama lii raada khibban kaada yurdiinii

verses.text: لِى وَجَّهَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَعْدَآءِهِ اللُّؤَمَا
verses.transcription: lii wajjahal yawma min ahdaa-ihil lu-amaa
ghanimatan fatahat lii baaba masmuuni

verses.text: جَزَآؤُهُ جَلَّ يُغْنِى عَنْ جَزَآ الْأُمَرَآ
verses.transcription: jazaa-uhu jalla yughnii han jazal umaraa
wa han tatallubi zirqin minhu madmuuni
azaala kasfun ataanii minhu mughtariban
hindal hidaa kulla iskaalin wa takhmiini
aataaniyal waasihul mughnii bilaa salabin
wat-han wa faydan bitabshiirin wa taamiini

verses.text: أُثْنِى عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَهْوَ اللَّهُ جَلَّ عَلَا
verses.transcription: usnii halal haqqi wahwal laahu jalla halaa
wa bil karaamati fid daarayni yahmiinii
lii jaada bil kasfi wat tawfiiqi zaa madadin
wa lii yuhayyiinu haqqan kulla tah-yiini

verses.text: حَطَّ الْعُيُوبَ مَعَ الْأَثْقَالِ عَنْ قِبَلِى
verses.transcription: hattal huyuuba mahal asqaali han qibalii
kamaa kafaanii muqaasaatash shayaatiini

verses.text: قَوَّى الْعَزِيزُ الَّذِى مَا زَالَ مُقْتَدِرًا
verses.transcription: qawwal haziizul lazii maa zaala muqtadiran
duhfii fasaalamanii kullus salaatiini
quluubuhum lil lazii akhtaaruhun sarafat
bikawnihi liya fii baadin wa maknuuni
wasiqtu bil waahidil qahhaari munsarifan
hanil manaahii wa han afhaali majnuuni

verses.text: زِدْتُّ الْمَتَابَ لِرَبٍ رَّدَّ لِى سِلَعِى
verses.transcription: zidttul mataaba lirabin radda lii silahii
bahdash tiraa-in bifat-hil  ghayba yughtiinii
huwal khabiirul lazii bil ghaybi yukhbirunii
wa bil fuyuudaati wal amdaadi yaatiinii
qalbii wa jismii wa kullil laahu yahfazuhaa

verses.text: مِنَ الْمَفَاسِدِ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ مِنْ حِينِى
verses.transcription: minal mafaasidi fid daarayni min hiinii

verses.text: إِلَيْهِ قَدْ تُّبْتُ مِنْ نَّقْضِى الْعُهُودِ مَعًا
verses.transcription: ilayhi qad tubtu min naqdil huhuudi mahan

verses.text: وَمِنْ جَمِيعِ الَّذِى لَمْ يَرْضَ لِى حِينِى
verses.transcription: wa min jamiihil lazii lam yarda lii hiinii
lahu mataabii wa bayhii raajiyan abadan
ghufraanahu wahwa bil qur-aani yashfiinii

verses.text: بَانَ الْهُدَى لِى وَلَآ أَبْغِى بِهِ بَدَلًا
verses.transcription: baanal hudaa lii walaa abghii bihi badalan
wa sunnatul mustafaa baydaa-u takfiinii
anfii bihaa baatilan hannii wa atruduhu

verses.text: وَإِنْ ظَمِأْتُ فَفَيْضُ اللَّهِ لِى وَلَهُ
verses.transcription: wa in zami-tu fafaydul laahi lii wa lahu

verses.text: طَابَ اغْتِرَابِى بِكَوْنِ اللَّهِ لِى وَلَهُ
verses.transcription: taabagh tiraabii bikawnil laahi lii wa lahu
hamdii wa shukrii wa bil maahii yuraqqiinii
lahul tijaa-i bihi habdan bisunnatihi
wa astahiizu bihi min kulli malhuuni
ijhal midaadii wa aqlaamii bikun malikii
bushral muqaffaa wa bushraa huurikal hiini

verses.text: نَبَذْتُ مَا كَانَ عِنْدِى فَلْتَسُقْ بَدَلًا
verses.transcription: nabaztu maa kaana hindii faltasuq badalan

verses.text: لِّى سَرْمَدًا وَلْتَهَبْ لِى خَيْرَ تَمْكِينِ
verses.transcription: lii sarmadan waltahab lii khayra tamkiini
najjaytanii min azal ahdaa-i mukhtariban
fajud bikawniya zaa hawdin wa taskini
azhabta hannil azaa bil mustafaa karaman

verses.text: هَبْ لِى تَلَازُمَ مَا تَرْضَى بِتَحْسِينِ
verses.transcription: hab lii talaazuma maa tardaa bitahsiini
lakas sanaa war ridaa  minnii wa mahmadatun
yaa man firaahu azal ahdaa-i yunsiinii

verses.text: بَيَّنْتَ لِى الْحَقَّ فِى يَوْمِ الْخَمِيسِ لَدَى
verses.transcription: bayyanta lil haqqa fii yawmil khamiisi ladaa

verses.text: كَوْنِى غَرِيبًا كَذِى الْوَادِى وَذِى النُّونِ
verses.transcription: kawnii ghariiban kazil waadii wa zin nuuni

verses.text: أَنْقِدْ وَلِى اكْشِفْ عُلُومًا تَزْدَرِى دِيَمًا
verses.transcription: anqid wa lik shif huluuman tazdarii diyaman
wa jud bisirrin haziimin minka maknuuni
tayyabta nafsii fazid tat-yiibahaa abadan
wajhal hayaatiya ajran ghayra mamnuuni

verses.text: لِى كُنْ بِجُودٍ وَتَكْرِيمِ بِلَا سَلَبٍ
verses.transcription: lii kun bijuudin wa takriimi bilaa salabin
walaa hisaabin wa suq lii khayra makhzuuni

verses.text: كُفَّ الْأَذَى سَرْمَدًا لِّلْغَيْرِ صُنْ قِبَلِى
verses.transcription: kuffal azaa sarmadan lil ghayri sun qibalii
dunyaa wa ukhraa khadiiman ghayra makhzuuni

verses.text: اجْعَلْ حِسَابِىَ مَا لَا قَيْتُهُ وَمَضَى
verses.transcription: ijhal hisaabiya maa laa qaytuhu wa madaa
hindan nasaaraa ghadan yawmal mawaaziini
najjaytanil yawma minhum bahda satwatihim
fazid najaatii wa jud lii bil makhaaziini

verses.text: زِدْنِى عُلُومًا وَزِدْ سَعْيِى وَزِدْ أَدَبِى
verses.transcription: zidnii huluuman wa zid sahyii wa zid adabii
yaa man minal haari wan naarayni tunjiinii

verses.text: هَبْ لِى بِقَهْرِكَ قَهْرِى جُمْلَةَ اللُّؤَمَا
verses.transcription: hab lii biqahrika qahrii jumlatal lu-amaa
wal takfinii ahla zaqquumin wa sijjiini
wa qaytaniihim wa rudtal kulla lii zululan

verses.text: مِنْ بَعْدِ كَوْنِى كَمَا سُورٍ وَمَسْجُونِ
verses.transcription: min bahdi kawnii kamaa suurin wa masjuuni

verses.text: قِنِى جَمِيعَ الَّذِى لَمْ تَرْضَ لِى صَمَدِى
verses.transcription: qinii jamiihal lazii lam tardaa lii samadii
yaa man kafaanii khabiisan kaada yurdiinii
uktub salaatan bitasniimin lisayyidinaa
muhammadin man bihi lil haqqi tahdiinii

bayts.text: وَجَّهْتُ لِلَّهِ وَجْهِى وَهْوَ يُبْقِنِى ۞ وَبِالَّذِى فَاقَ ظَنِّى قَدْ يُلَقِّينِى

translations.it.karamati: Ho rivolto ad Allah il mio volto, ed Egli mi fa permanere, e con ciò che ha superato la mia stima mi fa incontrare.
translations.en.karamati: I have turned my face to Allah, and He makes me abide, and with what surpassed my expectation He lets me meet.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai tourné vers Allah ma face, et Il me fait demeurer, et par ce qui a dépassé mon estime Il me fait rencontrer.

bayts.text: قَوْلِى وَعَقْدِى وَفِعْلِى لِلْعَلِى انْصَرَفَتْ ۞ وَالْعَامَ لِى رَاضَ خِبًّا كَادَ يُرْدِينِى

translations.it.karamati: La mia parola, il mio credo e la mia azione si sono rivolti all'Altissimo, e quest'anno Egli ha domato per me un ingannatore che quasi mi mandava in rovina.
translations.en.karamati: My word, my creed and my deed have turned to the Most High, and this year He tamed for me a deceiver who almost ruined me.
translations.fr.karamati: Ma parole, ma croyance et mon action se sont tournées vers le Très-Haut, et cette année Il a dompté pour moi un fourbe qui faillit me perdre.

bayts.text: لِى وَجَّهَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَعْدَآءِهِ اللُّؤَمَا ۞ غَنِمَةً فَتَحَتْ لِى بَابَ مَثْمُونِ

translations.it.karamati: Egli ha volto verso di me oggi, dai Suoi nemici, gli ignobili, un bottino che mi ha aperto la porta di un (tesoro) prezioso.
translations.en.karamati: He turned toward me today, from His enemies, the base, a spoil that opened for me the door of a precious (treasure).
translations.fr.karamati: Il a tourné vers moi aujourd'hui, de Ses ennemis, les vils, un butin qui m'a ouvert la porte d'un (trésor) précieux.

bayts.text: جَزَآؤُهُ جَلَّ يُغْنِى عَنْ جَزَآ الْأُمَرَآ ۞ وَعَنْ تَطَلُّبِ زِرْقٍ مِّنْهُ مَضْمُونِ

translations.it.karamati: La Sua ricompensa — sia esaltato — rende indipendenti dalla ricompensa degli emiri, e dal cercare una provvista che da Lui è garantita.
translations.en.karamati: His reward — exalted be He — frees from the reward of the emirs, and from seeking a provision guaranteed by Him.
translations.fr.karamati: Sa récompense — qu'Il soit exalté — rend indépendant de la récompense des émirs, et de la recherche d'une subsistance qui de Lui est garantie.

bayts.text: أَزَالَ كَثْفٌ أَتَانِى مِنْهُ مُغْتَرِبًا ۞ عِنْدَ الْعِدَى كُلَّ إِشْكَالٍ وَتَخْمِينِ

translations.it.karamati: Uno svelamento che mi è giunto da Lui, esule presso i nemici, ha rimosso ogni ambiguità e congettura.
translations.en.karamati: An unveiling that came to me from Him, an exile among the enemies, removed every ambiguity and conjecture.
translations.fr.karamati: Un dévoilement qui m'est venu de Lui, exilé auprès des ennemis, a écarté toute ambiguïté et conjecture.

bayts.text: ئَاتَانِىَ الْوَاسِعُ الْمُغْنِى بِلَا سَلَبٍ ۞ وَتْحًا وَفَيْضًا بِتَبْشِيرٍ وَتَامِينِ

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha dato l'Immenso, Colui che arricchisce, senza spoliazione, apertura ed effusione, con buona novella e sicurezza.
translations.en.karamati: The All-Embracing, the Enricher, has given me, without despoiling, opening and outpouring, with glad tidings and safety.
translations.fr.karamati: M'a donné l'Immense, Celui qui enrichit, sans spoliation, ouverture et effusion, avec bonne nouvelle et sécurité.

bayts.text: أُثْنِى عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَهْوَ اللَّهُ جَلَّ عَلَا ۞ وَبِالْكَرَامَتِ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ يَحْمِينِى

translations.it.karamati: Lodo la Verità, ed Egli è Allah — sia esaltato e glorificato —, e con i prodigi nelle due Dimore mi protegge.
translations.en.karamati: I praise the Truth, and He is Allah — exalted and glorified be He —, and with charisms in the two Abodes He protects me.
translations.fr.karamati: Je loue la Vérité, et Il est Allah — qu'Il soit exalté et glorifié —, et par les prodiges dans les deux Demeures Il me protège.

bayts.text: لِى جَادَ بِالْكَثْفِ وَالتَّوْفِيقِ ذَامَدَدٍ ۞ وَلِى يُعَيِّنُ حَقًّا كُلَّ تَعْيِينِ

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha elargito lo svelamento e il favore propizio, dotato di soccorso, e per me designa, in verità, ogni designazione.
translations.en.karamati: He bestowed on me unveiling and enabling grace, possessed of succour, and for me He appoints, truly, every appointing.
translations.fr.karamati: Il m'a octroyé le dévoilement et l'assistance, doté de secours, et pour moi Il désigne, en vérité, toute désignation.

bayts.text: حَطَّ الْعُيُوبَ مَعَ الْأَثْقَالِ عَنْ قِبَلِى ۞ كَمَا كَفَانِى مُقَاسَاةَ الشَّيَاطِينِ

translations.it.karamati: Ha deposto i difetti insieme ai pesi da parte mia, come mi ha risparmiato il patire i satana.
translations.en.karamati: He laid down the faults together with the burdens on my part, as He spared me suffering the devils.
translations.fr.karamati: Il a déposé les défauts avec les fardeaux de ma part, comme Il m'a épargné de souffrir les démons.

bayts.text: قَوَّى الْعَزِيزُ الَّذِى مَا زَالَ مُقْتَدِرًا ۞ ضُعْفِى فَسَالَمَنِى كُلُّ السَّلَاطِينِ

translations.it.karamati: Il Potente, che non cessa di essere Onnipotente, ha rafforzato la mia debolezza, e hanno fatto pace con me tutti i sultani.
translations.en.karamati: The Mighty, Who never ceases to be All-Powerful, strengthened my weakness, and all the sultans made peace with me.
translations.fr.karamati: Le Puissant, qui ne cesse d'être Omnipotent, a fortifié ma faiblesse, et tous les sultans ont fait la paix avec moi.

bayts.text: قُلُوبُهُمْ لِلَّذِى أَخْتَارُهُ انْصَرَفَتْ ۞ بِكَوْنِهِ لِىَ فِى بَادٍ وَمَكْنُونِ

translations.it.karamati: I loro cuori si sono volti verso ciò che io scelgo, per il Suo essere per me nel manifesto e nel celato.
translations.en.karamati: Their hearts turned toward what I choose, by His being for me in the manifest and the hidden.
translations.fr.karamati: Leurs cœurs se sont tournés vers ce que je choisis, par Son être pour moi dans le manifeste et le caché.

bayts.text: وَثِقْتُ بِالْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ مُنْصَرِفًا ۞ عَنِ الْمَنَاهِى وَعَنْ أَفْعَالِ مَجْنُونِ

translations.it.karamati: Ho avuto fiducia nell'Unico, il Soggiogatore, volgendomi via dai divieti e dalle azioni del folle.
translations.en.karamati: I have trusted in the One, the Subduer, turning away from the prohibitions and from the deeds of a madman.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai eu confiance en l'Unique, le Dominateur, me détournant des interdits et des actions du fou.

bayts.text: زِدْتُّ الْمَتَابَ لِرَبٍ رَّدَّ لِى سِلَعِى ۞ بَعْدَ اشْتِرَآءٍ بِفَتْحِى الْغَيْبِ يُفْتِينِى

translations.it.karamati: Ho accresciuto il pentimento verso un Signore che mi ha restituito le mie merci dopo l'acquisto, con il mio aprire il mistero, e Lui mi illumina.
translations.en.karamati: I increased repentance toward a Lord Who returned my wares to me after the purchase, with my opening of the unseen, and He enlightens me.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai accru le repentir envers un Seigneur qui m'a rendu mes marchandises après l'achat, par mon ouverture du mystère, et Il m'éclaire.

bayts.text: هُوَ الْخَبِيرُ الَّذِى بِالْغَيْبِ يُخْبِرُنِى ۞ وَبِالْفُيُوضَاتِ وَالْأَمْدَادِ يَاتِينِى

translations.it.karamati: Egli è il Ben Informato (Al-Khabīr) che mi informa del mistero, e con le effusioni e i soccorsi viene a me.
translations.en.karamati: He is the All-Aware (Al-Khabīr) Who informs me of the unseen, and with outpourings and succours comes to me.
translations.fr.karamati: Il est le Parfaitement Informé (Al-Khabīr) qui m'informe du mystère, et par les effusions et les secours vient à moi.

bayts.text: قَلْبِى وَجِسْمِى وَكَلِّى اللَّهُ يَحْفَظُهَا ۞ مِنَ الْمَفَاسِدِ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ مِنْ حِينِى

translations.it.karamati: Il mio cuore, il mio corpo e tutto me, Allah li custodisce dalle corruzioni nelle due Dimore, dal mio (primo) tempo.
translations.en.karamati: My heart, my body and all of me, Allah guards them from corruptions in the two Abodes, from my (first) time.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon cœur, mon corps et tout mon être, Allah les garde des corruptions dans les deux Demeures, depuis mon (premier) temps.

bayts.text: إِلَيْهِ قَدْ تُّبْتُ مِنْ نَّقْضِى الْعُهُودِ مَعًا ۞ وَمِنْ جَمِيعِ الَّذِى لَمْ يَرْضَ لِى حِينِى

translations.it.karamati: A Lui mi sono già pentito della mia rottura dei patti, insieme, e di tutto ciò che Egli non ha gradito per me, fin dal mio (primo) tempo.
translations.en.karamati: To Him I have already repented of my breaking pacts, together, and of all that He did not approve for me, from my (first) time.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers Lui je me suis déjà repenti de ma rupture des pactes, ensemble, et de tout ce qu'Il n'a pas agréé pour moi, dès mon (premier) temps.

bayts.text: لَهُ مَتَابِى وَبَيْعِى رَاجِيًا أَبَدًا ۞ غُفْرَانَهُ وَهْوَ بِالْقُرْءَانِ يَشْفِينِى

translations.it.karamati: A Lui il mio pentimento e la mia vendita, sperando per sempre il Suo perdono; ed Egli con il Corano mi guarisce.
translations.en.karamati: To Him be my repentance and my sale, hoping forever for His forgiveness; and He heals me with the Qurʾān.
translations.fr.karamati: À Lui mon repentir et ma vente, espérant à jamais Son pardon ; et Il par le Coran me guérit.

bayts.text: بَانَ الْهُدَى لِى وَلَآ أَبْغِى بِهِ بَدَلًا ۞ وَسُنَّةُ الْمُصْطَفَى بَيْضَآءُ تَكْفِينِى

translations.it.karamati: Mi è apparsa la retta guida, e non cerco in cambio di essa un sostituto; e la Sunna luminosa del Prescelto mi basta.
translations.en.karamati: Guidance has appeared to me, and I seek no substitute for it; and the radiant Sunna of the Chosen suffices me.
translations.fr.karamati: La droite guidance m'est apparue, et je ne recherche pas en échange d'elle un substitut ; et la Sunna lumineuse de l'Élu me suffit.

bayts.text: أَنْفِى بِهَا بَاطِلًا عَنِّى وَأَطْرُدُهُ ۞ وَإِنْ ظَمِأْتُ فَفَيْضُ اللَّهِ لِى وَلَهُ

translations.it.karamati: Respingo per mezzo di essa il falso da me e lo scaccio; e se ho sete, l'effusione di Allah è per me, e (la lode) è Sua.
translations.en.karamati: Through it I repel falsehood from me and drive it away; and if I thirst, the outpouring of Allah is for me, and (praise) is His.
translations.fr.karamati: Je repousse par elle le faux de moi et le chasse ; et si j'ai soif, l'effusion d'Allah est pour moi, et (la louange) est à Lui.

bayts.text: طَابَ اغْتِرَابِى بِكَوْنِ اللَّهِ لِى وَلَهُ ۞ حَمْدِى وَشُكْرِى وَبِالْمَاحِى يُرَقِّينِى

translations.it.karamati: Il mio esilio è divenuto buono per l'essere di Allah per me; e a Lui la mia lode e la mia gratitudine; e per mezzo del Cancellatore Egli mi fa ascendere.
translations.en.karamati: My exile became good through Allah's being for me; and to Him be my praise and my gratitude; and through the Effacer He makes me ascend.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon exil est devenu bon par l'être d'Allah pour moi ; et à Lui ma louange et ma gratitude ; et par l'Effaceur Il me fait monter.

bayts.text: لَهُ الْتِجَآءِ بِهِ عَبْدًا بِسُنَّتِهِ ۞ وَأَسْتَعِيذُ بِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَلْعُونِ

translations.it.karamati: A Lui il mio rifugiarmi per mezzo di lui (il Profeta), servo, con la sua Sunna, e cerco rifugio in Lui da ogni maledetto.
translations.en.karamati: To Him is my taking refuge through him (the Prophet), a slave, with his Sunna, and I seek refuge in Him from every accursed one.
translations.fr.karamati: À Lui mon refuge par lui (le Prophète), serviteur, par sa Sunna, et je cherche refuge en Lui contre tout maudit.

bayts.text: اجْعَلْ مِدَادِى وَأَقْلَامِى بِكُنْ مَّلِكِى ۞ بُشْرَى الْمُقَفَّى وَبُشْرَى حُورِكَ الْعِينِ

translations.it.karamati: Rendi il mio inchiostro e le mie penne, con «Sii», o mio Re, la buona novella del Seguito e la buona novella delle Tue urì dagli occhi grandi.
translations.en.karamati: Make my ink and my pens, with "Be", O my King, the glad tidings of the Followed and the glad tidings of Your wide-eyed houris.
translations.fr.karamati: Rends mon encre et mes plumes, par « Sois », ô mon Roi, la bonne nouvelle du Suivi et la bonne nouvelle de Tes houris aux grands yeux.

bayts.text: نَبَذْتُ مَا كَانَ عِنْدِى فَلْتَسُقْ بَدَلًا ۞ لِّى سَرْمَدًا وَلْتَهَبْ لِى خَيْرَ تَمْكِينِ

translations.it.karamati: Ho rigettato ciò che era presso di me: sospingimi dunque un sostituto per sempre, e donami la migliore saldezza.
translations.en.karamati: I have cast away what was with me: so drive to me a substitute forever, and grant me the best establishment.
translations.fr.karamati: J'ai rejeté ce qui était auprès de moi : amène-moi donc un substitut à jamais, et accorde-moi le meilleur affermissement.

bayts.text: نَجَّيْتَنِى مِنْ أَذَى الْأَعْدَآءِ مُخْتَرِبًا ۞ فَجُدْ بِكَوْنِىَ ذَا عَوْدٍ وَتَسْكِنِ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai salvato dal nocumento dei nemici, esule: elargiscimi dunque il mio essere dotato di ritorno e di quiete.
translations.en.karamati: You saved me from the harm of the enemies, an exile: so grant me to be possessed of return and repose.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as sauvé du dommage des ennemis, exilé : octroie-moi donc mon être doté de retour et de repos.

bayts.text: أَذْهَبْتَ عَنِّى الْأَذَى بِالْمُصْطَفَى كَرَمًا ۞ هَبْ لِى تَلَازُمَ مَا تَرْضَى بِتَحْسِينِ

translations.it.karamati: Hai portato via da me il nocumento per mezzo del Prescelto, per generosità: donami la perseveranza in ciò di cui Ti compiaci, con il miglioramento.
translations.en.karamati: You took harm away from me through the Chosen, out of generosity: grant me perseverance in what pleases You, with betterment.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as emporté de moi le dommage par l'Élu, par générosité : accorde-moi la persévérance en ce dont Tu Te satisfais, avec l'amélioration.

bayts.text: لَكَ الثَّنَآ وَالرِّضَى مِنِّى وَمَحْمَدَةٌ ۞ يَامَنْ فِرَاهُ أَذَى الْأَعْدَآءِ يُنْسِينِى

translations.it.karamati: A Te la lode, il compiacimento da parte mia e la lode, o Tu la cui ospitalità mi fa dimenticare il nocumento dei nemici.
translations.en.karamati: To You be praise, good pleasure from me and laudation, O You Whose hospitality makes me forget the harm of the enemies.
translations.fr.karamati: À Toi l'éloge, l'agrément de ma part et la louange, ô Toi dont l'hospitalité me fait oublier le dommage des ennemis.

bayts.text: بَيَّنْتَ لِى الْحَقَّ فِى يَوْمِ الْخَمِيسِ لَدَى ۞ كَوْنِى غَرِيبًا كَذِى الْوَادِى وَذِى النُّونِ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai mostrato la Verità il giorno del giovedì, quando ero straniero come quello della valle (Mosè) e quello del pesce (Giona).
translations.en.karamati: You showed me the Truth on Thursday, when I was a stranger like the one of the valley (Moses) and the one of the fish (Jonah).
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as montré la Vérité le jour du jeudi, quand j'étais étranger comme celui de la vallée (Moïse) et celui du poisson (Jonas).

bayts.text: أَنْقِدْ وَلِى اكْشِفْ عُلُومًا تَزْدَرِى دِيَمًا ۞ وَجُدْ بِسِرٍّ عَظِيمٍ مِّنْكَ مَكْنُونِ

translations.it.karamati: Salvami e svelami scienze che sminuiscano le piogge perenni, ed elargiscimi un segreto immenso da parte Tua, celato.
translations.en.karamati: Save me and unveil for me sciences that belittle the steady rains, and bestow on me a mighty secret from You, hidden.
translations.fr.karamati: Sauve-moi et dévoile-moi des sciences qui dédaignent les pluies continues, et octroie-moi un secret immense de Ta part, caché.

bayts.text: طَيَّبْتَ نَفْسِى فَزِدْ تَطْيِيبَهَآ أَبَدًا ۞ وَاجْعَلْ حَيَاتِىَ أَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونِ

translations.it.karamati: Hai reso buona la mia anima: accresci dunque il suo rendersi buona per sempre, e rendi la mia vita una ricompensa ininterrotta.
translations.en.karamati: You made my soul good: so increase its being made good forever, and make my life an unfailing reward.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as rendu bonne mon âme : accrois donc son embellissement à jamais, et rends ma vie une récompense ininterrompue.

bayts.text: لِى كُنْ بِجُودٍ وَتَكْرِيمِ بِلَا سَلَبٍ ۞ وَلَاحِسَابٍ وَسُقْ لِى خَيْرَ مَخْزُونِ

translations.it.karamati: Sii per me con munificenza e onore senza spoliazione e senza rendiconto, e sospingimi il migliore (tesoro) custodito.
translations.en.karamati: Be for me with bounty and honour without despoiling and without reckoning, and drive to me the best stored (treasure).
translations.fr.karamati: Sois pour moi avec munificence et honneur sans spoliation et sans compte, et amène-moi le meilleur (trésor) gardé.

bayts.text: كُفَّ الْأَذَى سَرْمَدًا لِّلْغَيْرِ صُنْ قِبَلِى ۞ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى خَدِيمًا غَيْرَ مَخْزُونِ

translations.it.karamati: Trattieni il nocumento per sempre verso altri; preserva la mia parte, nel mondo e nell'Altro, servitore non rattristato.
translations.en.karamati: Hold back harm forever toward others; guard my side, in this world and the Next, a servant not saddened.
translations.fr.karamati: Retiens le dommage à jamais vers d'autres ; préserve mon côté, dans ce monde et dans l'Autre, serviteur non attristé.

bayts.text: اجْعَلْ حِسَابِىَ مَا لَا قَيْتُهُ وَمَضَى ۞ عِنْدَ النَّصَارَى غَدًا يَوْمَ الْمَوَازِينِ

translations.it.karamati: Rendi il mio rendiconto ciò che ho incontrato ed è trascorso presso i cristiani, domani, nel giorno delle bilance.
translations.en.karamati: Make my reckoning what I met and what passed among the Christians, tomorrow, on the day of the scales.
translations.fr.karamati: Rends mon compte ce que j'ai rencontré et qui est passé auprès des chrétiens, demain, au jour des balances.

bayts.text: نَجَّيْتَنِى الْيَوْمَ مِنْهُمْ بَعْدَ سَطْوَتِهِمْ ۞ فَزِدْ نَجَاتِى وَجُدْ لِى بِالْمَخَازِينِ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai salvato oggi da loro dopo il loro assalto: accresci dunque la mia salvezza ed elargiscimi i tesori.
translations.en.karamati: You saved me today from them after their onslaught: so increase my salvation and bestow the treasuries on me.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as sauvé aujourd'hui d'eux après leur assaut : accrois donc mon salut et octroie-moi les trésors.

bayts.text: زِدْنِى عُلُومًا وَزِدْ سَعْيِى وَزِدْ أَدَبِى ۞ يَامَنْ مِّنَ الْعَارِ وَالنَّارَيْنِ تُنْجِينِى

translations.it.karamati: Accrescimi in scienze, accresci il mio impegno e accresci la mia buona educazione, o Tu che dalla vergogna e dai due fuochi mi salvi.
translations.en.karamati: Increase me in sciences, increase my striving and increase my refinement, O You Who save me from disgrace and the two fires.
translations.fr.karamati: Accrois-moi en sciences, accrois mon effort et accrois ma bonne éducation, ô Toi qui de la honte et des deux feux me sauves.

bayts.text: هَبْ لِى بِقَهْرِكَ قَهْرِى جُمْلَةَ اللُّؤَمَا ۞ وَلْتَكْفِنِى أَهْلَ زَقُّومٍ وَسِجِّينِ

translations.it.karamati: Donami, con il Tuo dominio, il mio dominare l'insieme degli ignobili, e risparmiami la gente dello Zaqqūm e del Sijjīn.
translations.en.karamati: Grant me, by Your might, my mastering all the base, and spare me the people of Zaqqūm and Sijjīn.
translations.fr.karamati: Accorde-moi, par Ta domination, ma domination sur l'ensemble des vils, et épargne-moi les gens du Zaqqūm et du Sijjīn.

bayts.text: وَقَيْتَنِيهِمْ وَرُضْتَ الْكَلَّ لِى ذُلُلًا ۞ مِنْ بَعْدِ كَوْنِى كَمَا سُورٍ وَمَسْجُونِ

translations.it.karamati: Me li hai risparmiati e li hai domati tutti per me, docili, dopo il mio essere stato come un prigioniero e un incarcerato.
translations.en.karamati: You spared me them and tamed them all for me, docile, after I had been like a captive and a prisoner.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu me les as épargnés et les as tous domptés pour moi, dociles, après que j'ai été comme un captif et un emprisonné.

bayts.text: قِنِى جَمِيعَ الَّذِى لَمْ تَرْضَ لِى صَمَدِى ۞ يَامَنْ كَفَانِى خَبِيثًا كَادَ يُرْدِينِى

translations.it.karamati: Preservami da tutto ciò che non hai gradito per me, o mio Assoluto, o Tu che mi hai risparmiato un malvagio che quasi mi mandava in rovina.
translations.en.karamati: Protect me from all that You did not approve for me, O my Eternal Refuge, O You Who spared me a wicked one who almost ruined me.
translations.fr.karamati: Préserve-moi de tout ce que Tu n'as pas agréé pour moi, ô mon Absolu, ô Toi qui m'as épargné un méchant qui faillit me perdre.

bayts.text: أُكْتُبْ صَلَاةً بِتَسْنِيمٍ لِّسَيِّدِنَا ۞ مُحَمَّدٍ مَّنْ بِهِ لِلْحَقِّ تَهْدِينِى

translations.it.karamati: Scrivi una benedizione con il Tasnīm (fonte del Paradiso) per nostro signore Muḥammad, colui per mezzo del quale mi guidi alla Verità.
translations.en.karamati: Write a blessing with Tasnīm (the spring of Paradise) for our master Muḥammad, him through whom You guide me to the Truth.
translations.fr.karamati: Écris une bénédiction avec le Tasnīm (source du Paradis) pour notre maître Muḥammad, celui par qui Tu me guides vers la Vérité.
